description: This file is a Go source file implementing WiFi reset dialog UI and associated logic, integrating CGO C code calls for network tree management, and handling MAC address validation and reset commands.

methods.name: printTree
methods.description: Prints the network tree structure for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getInterfacePrefence
methods.description: Recursively traverses network tree to extract interface MAC addresses.

methods.name: updateCollocatedAgentID
methods.description: Updates the CollocatedAgentID in the reset configuration tree with a specified MAC address.

methods.name: applyResetConfig
methods.description: Executes the reset command on the network tree.

methods.name: getTreeValue
methods.description: Helper to get value for a given key in the network tree.
